notes.title: [Update v1.1] Crystal Cosmos is Here! *New Level* + [Weekend Sale] *-60% OFF Now!*
notes.content:
[h1][b]Crystal Cosmos for $ 1.99 *-60% OFF Now!*[/b][/h1]

http://store.steampowered.com/app/496590

[h1][b]A brand new level, The Cursed Graveyard unlocks after finishing the story. [/b][/h1]

[b]Explore a graveyard filled with the undead and followers of the mysterious "Stone God". Featuring brand new enemies, music, and a fierce new boss.[/b]
 
[b]- Patch Notes:[/b]
[list]
[*]The HUD now displays how much score you are receiving from enemies.
[*]The HUD now displays how many shards you are receiving from pickups.
[*]Changed ability ready effect to a rainbow color to improve visibility.
[*]Damage text spawn rate is now limited to avoid large memory spikes.
[*]Shards spawned from enemies now appear in correct positions.
[*]Shards will now move apart more making them a little more challenging to collect.
[*]Increased size of Obsidious hit box.
[*]Changed spawn pattern of Reapers during Obsidious fight.
[*]Fixed an issue where the collision on destroyed circle satellites would not properly turn off.
[*]Various other Bug Fixes.
[/list]

[img]http://otakumaker.com/images/crystal_cosmos_cover_616x353.png[/img]

[b]Please restart Steam if the update isn't downloading.[/b]

[h1][b]Enjoy![/b][/h1]

Sea Beast Productions & OtakuMaker.com Studio
